'''Jerrahg''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and owner of [[Tailfin Cantina]], in the [[Center Sphere District|Center Sphere]] district of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. By that point, Jerrahg was already old and considered to be friendly and gruff at the same time. He used to tell stories about fish and had a skill to obtain the money of newcomers.
